dedupe_keys.name: european commission s joint research centre wildfire hazard datasets

description: European Commission's Joint Research Centre: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Commission's Joint Research Centre. Coverage: European Commission's Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Burnt Area 2018-present (raster 300 m), global, monthly - version 4; Burnt Area 2023-present (raster 300 m), global, daily - version 3; Burnt Area 2019-present (raster 300 m), global, monthly - version 3; Burnt Area 2025-present (raster 300 m), global, daily - version 4. Formats seen: WMTS, NETCDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
